missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Читатель' is the masculine nominative subject. 'Этот' points at him and 'внимательный' is the agreeing adjective. A clean descriptive frame for a person.

Strategic focus: Animate accusative. 'Читателя' takes the genitive-like accusative because читатель is animate masculine. 'Каждого' agrees in the animate accusative. A core animacy pattern with a soft-stem noun.

missions.phrase: В зале нет ни одного читателя.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Читателя' is genitive after 'ни одного' to stress total absence. 'В зале' is prepositional location. A useful pattern for an empty room.

Strategic focus: Dative experiencer. 'Читателю' is the dative experiencer, the one to whom the book appealed. 'Молодому' agrees in the masculine dative, and 'книга' is the nominative subject. A natural reaction sentence.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of accompaniment. 'Читателем' is instrumental after 'с' to mark whom the writer met. 'Верным' agrees in the masculine instrumental. A natural event sentence.

missions.phrase: В читателе живёт любовь к словам.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В читателе' uses the prepositional form 'читателе' after 'в' to locate a quality within the person. 'Любовь к словам' is the nominative subject. A reflective sentence.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Читатель' is the nominative subject of 'видит'. 'Каждый' agrees, 'книгу' is the accusative object, and 'по-своему' adds manner. A thoughtful general statement.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Читатели' is the nominative plural subject of 'любят'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'детективы' is the accusative object. Good for plural practice.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative plural. 'Читателей' takes the genitive-plural ending as the animate accusative plural of 'благодарит'. 'Своих' agrees. Reinforces animacy in the plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Читателей' is the genitive plural required after 'много'. 'Постоянных' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'в библиотеке' is prepositional location.
